clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Xabraxxis uses the Talisman of Corruption to turn the Blackwood furbolgs against their former allies. The satyr keeps it in his personal pouch, where its magic binds the tribe to fel madness.

Auberdine's night elves have long sought the cause of the Blackwood furbolgs' turn against their former allies. Thundris Windweaver found that satyrs had brought about the tribe's fall. With talismans like this, demonic agents spread corrupting sorcery through the wilderness, tainting food and twisting peaceful forest spirits into frenzied beasts. The devices channel fel magic that grips the minds and wills of local tribes.
